_comment: Issue #970 re-examination of the #955 sweep. NOT a register manifest and NOT discovered by check-negative-controls: it is read only when named explicitly, `mutation-probe.py --manifest docs/research/class-enumeration-2026-09-15/mutations.json`. Its mutations are applied to sweep.py's REAL source, which is the difference from the sweep's own --self-test. The battery is run_controls() ALONE, not `sweep.py`, and deliberately: the sweep's bucket controls are currently RED on main (the #591 claim that eli5-core-drift.sh is unautomated was falsified by tests/test_codex_skill_sync.py, which invokes it through subprocess.run), so a whole-program battery would be red before any mutation and score nothing. Isolating the committed CONTROL_CASES is what makes the answer about THEM.
battery: import importlib.util,sys;spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('sweep','sweep.py');m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m);f=m.run_controls(verbose=False);print('SWEEP_CONTROL_FAIL: '+', '.join(x[0] for x in f)) if f else print('sweep controls: all cases behaved as registered');sys.exit(1 if f else 0)

mutations.name: cmdpos
mutations.protection: an invocation must sit in COMMAND POSITION; a line merely beginning with the name is prose

mutations.name: quote
mutations.protection: a name inside a quoted run is advice or test data, not an invocation
mutations.find: if m and not _in_quoted_string\(line, m\.end\(\) - len\(name\)\):

mutations.name: interp
mutations.protection: an interpreter must sit at a token start, so '.sh' inside a quoted filename cannot act as one

mutations.name: comment
mutations.protection: a commented-out invocation is not an invocation

mutations.name: ast
mutations.protection: a PYTHON file is read with ast, so a docstring cannot register as an invocation
